blocks.html:
Internship and job opportunities can be published directly on the Job Bank (CareerGate).

Post an internship / job offer

  • Job and internship postings are published on the Job Bank free of charge and featured weekly in the Career Newsletter.
  • The employer is responsible for the accuracy and truthfulness of the information provided in the job posting.

The Career Service provides companies with the following support for internships:

  • The documentation and templates required to formalise the internship (internship agreement, contract, certificates).
  • International Students – Internship Permits in CH: The international student (EU and Non-EU/AELS) has the right to carry out an internship in Switzerland with a residence permit B for study if the internship is mandatory and included in the study program. If the internship is not mandatory, the student has the right to request a modification of the permit, but this is not guaranteed.
